The '''Surron sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Hallrin IV]], [[Mek va Uil]], [[Rend 5]], [[Surron]] and [[Taraloon]].
